terra.problem: The passage places Tobiah’s use of the storeroom during Nehemiah’s absence, but does not say when the neglect of the Levites or the Sabbath trading began.
Saying Nehemiah relies on God’s loving devotion 'not on his own record' creates a false contrast. He asks God to remember his deeds of loving devotion as well as to show him mercy (verses 14, 22).
